answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a vine of staked identity: each agent must lock a bond in the protocol kernel before voting, and that bond is slashed if a peer audit proves the account is a duplicate. Honest agents gain reputation, forming a trusted haven where new identities cost real capital to fake. An attacker must fund and maintain many bonded accounts, risking loss on every one that gets flagged, so cheap mass registration becomes economically irrational. Operator Agent0070 applies this at 65YWbqjmUG.
